arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ فِي رَوْعِي مِنَ التَّمَنِّي وَالتَّظَنِّي وَالْحَسَـدِ ذِكْـراً لِعَظَمَتِكَ، وَتَفَكُّراً فِي قُدْرَتِكَ، وَتَدْبِيراً عَلَى عَدُوِّكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ijʿal mā yulqī al-shayṭān fī rawʿī min al-tamannī wa al-taẓannī wa al-ḥasad dhikran liʿaẓamatika wa tafakkuran fi qudratika wa tadbeeraan ʿalaa ʿaduwwika
english_text: O God, make the wishing, the doubt, and the envy which Satan throws into my heart a remembrance of Thy mightiness, a reflection upon Thy power, and a devising against Thy enemy!

arabic_text: وَمَا أَجْرَى عَلَى لِسَانِي مِنْ لَفْظَةِ فُحْش أَوْ هُجْر أَوْ شَتْمِ عِرْض أَوْ شَهَادَةِ بَاطِل أو اغْتِيَابِ مُؤْمِن غَائِبِ أَوْ سَبِّ حَاضِر، وَمَا أَشْبَهَ ذَلِكَ نُطْقاً بِالْحَمْدِ لَكَ
transliteration: wa mā ajrā ʿalā lisānī min lafẓati fuhshin aw hujr aw shatmi ʿirḍin aw shahādati bāṭil aw ightiyabi mu'min gha'ibin aw sabb haadir wa mā ashbahadhā nuṭqan bil-ḥamdi laka
english_text: Make everything he causes to pass over my tongue, - the indecent or ugly words, the maligning of good repute, the false witness, the speaking ill of an absent man of faith or the reviling of one present, and all things similar - a speech in praise of Thee,

arabic_text: وَإغْرَاقاً فِي الثَّنَاءِ عَلَيْكَ، وَذَهَاباً فِي تَمْجيدِكَ وَشُكْراً لِنِعْمَتِكَ وَاعْتِرَافاً بِإحْسَانِكَ
transliteration: wa ʾighrāqan fī althannāʾi ʿalayk wa dhahaban fi tamjeedik wa shukran li ni'matik waʿtirafan bi-ihsanika
english_text: a pursual of eulogizing Thee, an excursion in magnifying Thee, a thanksgiving for Thy favour, an acknowledgement of Thy beneficence,

arabic_text: وَإحْصَاءً لِمِنَنِكَ.
transliteration: wa-ihsā'an liminannika
english_text: and an enumeration of Thy kindnesses!

arabic_text: أللّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَلاَ اُظْلَمَنَّ وَأَنْتَ مُطِيقٌ لِلدَّفْعِ عَنِّي، وَلا أَظْلِمَنَّ وَأَنْتَ القَادِرُ عَلَى الْقَبْضِ مِنِّي، وَلاَ أَضِلَّنَّ وَقَدْ أَمْكَنَتْكَ هِدَايَتِي،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa lā uẓ'laman wa anta muṭīqun lid-daf'i 'anni walā ʾaẓlimanna waʾanta al-qādiru ʿalā al-qabḍi minnī walā 'aḍillann waqad amkantaka hidāyatī
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, let me not be wronged while Thou canst repel from me, let me not do wrong while Thou art powerful over holding me back, let me not be misguided while Thou art able to guide me,

arabic_text: وَلاَ أَفْتَقِرَنَّ وَمِنْ عِنْدِكَ وُسْعِي، وَلا أَطْغَيَنَّ وَمِنْ عِنْدِكَ وُجْدِي.
transliteration: wala aftaqiranna wa min ʿindika wusʿi walā aṭghayanna wa min ʿindika wujdī
english_text: let me not be poor while with Thee is my plenty, let me not be insolent while from Thee comes my wealth!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إلَى مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَفَدْتُ، وَإلَى عَفْوِكَ قَصَـدْتُ، وَإلَى تَجَـاوُزِكَ اشْتَقْتُ، وَبِفَضْلِكَ وَثِقْتُ، وَلَيْسَ عِنْدِي مَا يُوجِبُ لِي مَغْفِرَتَكَ، وَلاَ فِي عَمَلِي مَا أَسْتَحِقُّ بِهِ عَفْوَكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ilā maghfiratika wafadtu, wa ilā ʿafwik qasadtu wa'ilā tajāwuzu-ka ʾishtaqtu, wa-bifaḍli-ka wa-thiqtu wa laysa ʿindi mā yūjibulī maghfirataka wala fi ʿamalī mā astaḥiqqu bihī ʿafwaka
english_text: O God, I come to Thy forgiveness, I go straight to Thy pardon, I yearn for Thy forbearance, and I trust in Thy bounty, but there is nothing with me to make me warrant Thy forgiveness, nothing in my works to make me merit Thy pardon,

arabic_text: وَمَا لِي بَعْدَ أَنْ حَكَمْتُ عَلَى نَفْسِي إلاَّ فَضْلُكَ، فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَتَفَضَّلْ عَلَيَّ
transliteration: wa mā lī baʿda an ḥakamtu ʿalā nafsī illā faḍluka faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa tafadhal 'alayya
english_text: and nothing on my behalf after I judge my soul but Thy bounty, so bless Muhammad and his Household and bestow Thy bounty upon me!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَنْطِقْنِي بِالْهُدى، وَأَلْهِمْنِي ألتَّقْـوَى وَوَفِّقْنِي لِلَّتِيْ هِيَ أَزْكَى وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِمَا هُوَ أَرْضَى.
transliteration: allāhumma wa anṭiqnī bil-hudā wa alhimnī al-taqwā wa waffiqnī lil-lati hiya azkā waastaʿmilni bimā huwa arḍā
english_text: O God, make my speech be guidance, inspire me with reverential fear, give me success in that which is most pure, and employ me in what is most pleasing to Thee!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اسْلُكْ بِيَ الطَّرِيقَـةَ الْمُثْلَى، وَاجْعَلْنِي عَلَى مِلَّتِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَى.
transliteration: allāhumma asluk biyaṭ-ṭarīqah al-muthla waaj'alni ʿalaa millatika amuutu wa ahyaa
english_text: O God, let me tread the most exemplary path and make me live and die in Thy creed!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَمَتِّعْنِي بِالاقْتِصَادِ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّدَادِ، وَمِنْ أَدِلَّةِ الرَّشَادِ، وَمِنْ صَالِحِي الْعِبَادِ، وَارْزُقْنِي فَوْزَ الْمَعَادِ، وَسَلاَمَةَ الْمِرْصَادِ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa mattiʿnī bil-iqtisād, wa-ijʿalnī min ahl al-siddād wa min adillatir-rashadi, wa min salihi-l-'ibad wa-rzuqni fawza al-maʿad wa-salamata al-mirsad
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, give me to enjoy moderation, make me into one of the people of right behaviour, the proofs of right conduct, and the servants of righteousness, and provide me with triumph at the place of Return and safety from the Ambush!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ خُذْ لِنَفْسِكَ مِنْ نَفْسِي مَـا يُخَلِّصُهَا، وَأَبْق لِنَفْسِي مِنْ نَفْسِي مَـا يُصْلِحُهَا; فَإنَّ نَفْسِي هَالِكَةٌ أَوْ تَعْصِمَهَا.
transliteration: allāhumma khudh li-nafsika min nafsī mā yukhallisuhā wa-abq li-nafsi min nafsi ma yuslihuha fa'inna nafsi halikatun aw taʿsimaha
english_text: O God, take to Thyself from my soul what will purify it and leave for my soul that of my soul that will set it right, for my soul will perish unless Thou preservest it!

arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عُدَّتِي إنْ حَزِنْتُ، وَأَنْتَ مُنْتَجَعِي إنْ حُرِمْتُ، وَبِكَ استِغَاثَتِي إنْ كَرِثْتُ، وَعِنْدَكَ مِمَّا فَاتَ خَلَفٌ، وَلِمَا فَسَدَ صَلاَحٌ،
transliteration: allāhumma anta ʿuddatī in hazintu wa anta muntajaʿī in ḥurimtu wa bika istighāthatī in karithtu waʿindaka mimmā fāta khalafun, wa limā fasada ṣalāḥun
english_text: O God, Thou art my stores when I sorrow, Thou art my recourse when I am deprived, from Thee I seek aid when troubled and with Thee is a substitute for everything gone by, a correction for everything corrupted,

arabic_text: وَفِيمَا أنْكَرْتَ تَغْييرٌ.
transliteration: wa fee maa ankarta taghyeerun
english_text: and a change from everything Thou disapprovest.

arabic_text: فَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ قَبْلَ الْبَلاءِ بِالْعَافِيَةِ، وَقَبْلَ الطَّلَبِ بِالْجِدةِ، وَقَبْلَ الضَّلاَلِ بِالرَّشَادِ، وَاكْفِنِي مَؤُونَةَ مَعَرَّةِ الْعِبَادِ، وَهَبْ لِيْ أَمْنَ يَوْمِ الْمَعَادِ، وَامْنَحنِي حُسْنَ الارْشَادِ.
transliteration: faamnun ʿalayya qabla al-balāʾi bil-ʿāfiyah, waqabla al-ṭalabi bil-jiddah wa-qabla al-ḍalāli bi al-rashād, wa-kfinī maʾūnat maʿarrat al-ʿibād wa-hab-li amna yawm al-ma'ad, wa-amnahni husna al-irshad
english_text: So show kindness to me with well-being before affliction, wealth before asking, right conduct before misguidance; suffice me against the burden of shame toward the servants, give me security on the Day of Return, and grant me excellent right guidance!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّـد وَآلِـهِ وَادْرَأ عَنّي بِلُطْفِـكَ، وَاغْـذُنِي بِنِعْمَتِكَ، وَأَصْلِحْنِي بِكَرَمِـكَ، وَدَاوِنِي بصُنْعِـكَ، وَأَظِلَّنِيْ فِي ذَرَاكَ، وجَلِّلْنِي رِضَـاكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wadraʾ ʿannī bilutfi-ka, wa-aghzhunī biniʿmati-ka wa aslihni bika ramik, wa dāwinī bi ṣunʿik wa-aẓillanī fī dharak, wajallilnī riḍāka
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, repel from me through Thy gentleness, feed me through Thy favour, set me right through Thy generosity, heal me through Thy benefaction, shade me in Thy shelter, wrap me in Thy good pleasure,

arabic_text: وَوَفِّقنِي إذَا اشْتَكَلَتْ عَلَيَّ الأمُـورُ لأِهْدَاهَـا، وَإذَا تَشَابَهَتِ الأعْمَالُ لأزْكَاهَا، وَإذَا تَنَاقَضَتِ الْمِلَلُ لأِرْضَاهَا.
transliteration: wa waffiqnī idhā ishtakaltu ʿalayya al-amūru li-ahdāhā wa idha tashabahatil a'malu li-azkahā wa idha tanāqadhat al-milalu li-ardhāhā
english_text: and give me success to reach the most guided of affairs when affairs confuse me, the purest of works when works seem similar, and the most pleasing to Thee of creeds when creeds conflict!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَتَوِّجْنِي بِالْكِفَايَةِ، وَسُمْنِي حُسْنَ الْوِلايَةِ، وَهَبْ لِيْ صِدْقَ الْهِدَايَةِ، وَلا تَفْتِنِّي بِالسَّعَةِ، وَامْنَحْنِي حُسْنَ الدَّعَةِ، وَلا تَجْعَلْ عَيْشِي كَدّاً كَدّاً،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa tawwijnii bilkifāyati, wa sumnii ḥusnal-wilāyah wa hab li ṣidq al-hidāyah, wa lā tafṭinnī bis-saʿah wa-amnahnī ḥusna al-dʿah, wa-lā tajʿal ʿayshī kaddān kaddān
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, crown me with sufficiency, place in me excellent guardianship, give me to guide correctly, tempt me not with plenty, grant me excellent ease, make not my life toil and trouble,

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَرُدَّ دُعَائِي عَلَيَّ رَدّاً; فَإنِّي لا أَجْعَلُ لَكَ ضِدّاً وَلا أَدْعُو مَعَكَ نِدّاً.
transliteration: wa lā turuddannā duʿāʾī ʿalayya raddan fa'inni la aj'alulika ḍiddan walā adʿū ma'aka niddan
english_text: and refuse not my supplication in rejection, for I make none rival to Thee and I supplicate none with Thee as equal!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّـد وَآلِـهِ وَامْنَعْنِي مِنَ السَّرَفِ وَحَصِّنْ رِزْقِي مِنَ التَّلَفِ، وَوَفِّرْ مَلَكَتِي بِالْبَرَكَةِ فِيهِ، وَأَصِبْ بِي سَبِيلَ الْهِدَايَةِ لِلْبِرِّ فِيمَا اُنْفِقُ مِنْهُ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa-amnaʿnī mina s-sarafi wa-ḥaṣṣin rizqī mina t-talafi wa waffir malakati bil-barakati fiih wa-aṣib biy sabīl al-hidāyati lilbirri fīmā onfiqu minhu
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, hold me back from prodigality, fortify my provision against ruin, increase my possessions through blessing them, and set me upon the path of guidance through piety in what I spend!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاكْفِنِي مَؤُونَةَ الاكْتِسَابِ، وَارْزُقْنِي مِنْ غَيْرِ احْتِسَاب، فَلاَ أَشْتَغِلَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِكَ بِالطَّلَبِ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wākfinī maʾūnat al-iktisāb wa-arzuqni min ghayr ihtisab fala ash taghila ʿan ʿibadatika bit talabi
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, spare me the burden of earning, and provide for me without reckoning, lest I be distracted from Thy worship through seeking

arabic_text: وَلا أَحْتَمِلَ إصْرَ تَبِعَاتِ الْمَكْسَبِ.
transliteration: wa lā aḥtamila iṣra tabiʿāt al-maksab
english_text: and carry the load of earning's ill results!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ فَأَطْلِبْنِي بِقُدْرَتِكَ مَا أَطْلُبُ، وَأَجِرْنِي بِعِزَّتِكَ مِمَّا أَرْهَبُ.
transliteration: allāhumma fa'aṭlibnī biqudratika mā aṭlubu wa-ajirnī bi-ʿizzatika mimmā arhabu
english_text: O God, bestow upon me what I seek through Thy power and grant me sanctuary from what I fear through Thy might!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَصُنْ وَجْهِي بِالْيَسَارِ، وَلاَ تَبْتَذِلْ جَاهِي بِالإقْتارِ فَأَسْتَرْزِقَ أَهْلَ رِزْقِكَ، وَأَسْتَعْطِيَ شِرَارَ خَلْقِكَ، فَأفْتَتِنَ بِحَمْدِ مَنْ أَعْطَانِي، وَاُبْتَلَى بِـذَمِّ مَنْ مَنَعَنِي وَأَنْتَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ وَلِيُّ الإعْطَاءِ وَالْمَنْعِ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa ṣun wajhī bil yasār wala tabtadhil jahi bi al-iqtar fa astarziq ahla rizqika wa-astaʿtiya shirāra khalqika, fa-afatatina bi-hamdi man ʾaʿtānī wa 'ubtila bi-thammi man manaʿanī wa 'anta min dūnihim wa waliyyu al-iʿtāʾi wal-maniʿi
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, save my face through ease, and demean not my dignity through neediness, lest I seek provision from those whom Thou hast provided and asks for bestowal from the worst of Thy creatures! Then I would be tried by praising him who gave to me and afflicted with blaming him who held back from me, while Thou - not they - art patron of giving and holding back.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـةِ وَارْزُقْنِي صِحَّةً فِيْ عِبَادَة، وَفَراغاً فِي زَهَادَة، وَعِلْماً فِي اسْتِعمَـال، وَوَرَعـاً فِي إجْمَال.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih warzuqny ṣiḥḥatan fī ʿibādah wa faraghān fī zahādah waʿilman fi istiʿmal, wa waraʿan fi ijmal
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and provide me with soundness in worship, detachment in renunciation, knowledge put into action, and abstinence in measure!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اخْتِمْ بِعَفْوِكَ أَجَلي، وَحَقِّقْ فِي رَجَاءِ رَحْمَتِكَ أَمَلِي، وَسَهِّلْ إلَى بُلُوغِ رِضَاكَ سُبُلِي، وَحَسِّن فِي جَمِيعِ أَحْوَالِيْ عَمَلِي.
transliteration: allāhumma akhtim biʿafwik ajalī wa ḥaqqiq fī rajā'i raḥmatika amalī wa sahhil ila bulugh ridak subuli wa ḥassin fī jamīʿi aḥwālī ʿamalī
english_text: O God, seal my term with Thy pardon, verify my expectation in hoping for Thy mercy, smooth my paths to reach Thy good pleasure, and make my works good in all my states!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَنَبِّهْنِي لِذِكْرِكَ فِي أَوْقَاتِ الْغَفْلَةِ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِطَاعَتِـكَ فِي أَيَّامِ الْمُهْلَةِ، وَانْهَجْ لِي إلى مَحَبَّتِكَ سَبيلاً سَهْلَةً
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-nabbihni li-thikrika fi awqati al-ghaflah wa astaʿmilnī bi-ṭāʿatika fī ayyāmi al-muhlah wa-anhaj li ila mahabbatika sabeelan sahla
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, incite me to remember Thee in times of heedlessness, employ me in Thy obedience in days of disregard, open a smooth road for me to Thy love,

arabic_text: أكْمِلْ لِي بِهَا خَيْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِـرَةِ.
transliteration: akmil li bihā khayra al-dunyā wa-l-ākhira
english_text: and complete for me thereby the good of this world and the next

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَأَفْضَلِ مَـا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ قَبْلَهُ، وَأَنْتَ مُصَلٍّ عَلَى أَحَد بَعْدَهُ، وَآتِنا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih ka'afdali ma sallayta 'ala ahadin min khalkika qablahu wa anta musalliyan ʿalaa ahadin baʿdahu wa ātinā fī al-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fī al-ākhirati ḥasanatan
english_text: O God, and bless Muhammad and his Household the best Thou hast blessed any of Thy creatures before him and wilt bless any of them after him, and "give to us in this World good, and in the next world good" (2:201),

arabic_text: وَقِنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ النَّارِ.
transliteration: wa qinī bi-raḥmatika ʿadhāba al-nār
english_text: and protect me through Thy mercy "from the chastisement of the Fire" (2:201)!
